# Hastewire

> Hastewire is an AI humanizer and detector platform that converts AI-generated text to undetectable human-like content while providing accurate AI detection capabilities for creators, students, and enterprises.

Hastewire offers a comprehensive suite of tools including an AI humanizer, AI detector, grammar checker, and word counter. The platform serves students, marketers, content creators, and enterprises with integrations for Zapier, Google Docs, and WordPress, alongside detailed API documentation for developers.

## Key Topics

- AI Humanizer
- AI Detector
- ChatGPT Detection
- Content Humanization
- Undetectable Content
- Academic Integrity
- Claude & Gemini Support
- SEO Optimization
- Enterprise Solutions
- API Integration
- Plagiarism Detection
- AI Writing Tools
- Content Verification
- Grammar Checking
- Zapier Automation

## Core Tools

- [AI Humanizer](https://hastewire.com/ai-humanizer): Convert ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini text into undetectable human-like content with advanced humanization algorithms
- [AI Detector](https://hastewire.com/ai-detector): Detect AI-generated text from ChatGPT, Claude, GPT-5 and other models with sentence-level scoring and accuracy
- [Grammar Checker](https://hastewire.com/grammar-checker): Free AI-powered grammar, spelling, and punctuation checker with real-time writing assistance
- [Word Counter](https://hastewire.com/word-counter): Online word and character counter tool with readability analysis and reading time estimation
